receipt.public_excerpt: In this paper, we formalize the problem and show that it is impossible to eliminate hallucination in LLMs.

evidence_items.explanation: The argument concerns learning computable ground-truth functions in a specified formal world. It supports limits on universal correctness but does not identify a necessary new branch of mathematics or establish the same result for every practical deployment.
